title: Office & Commercial Movers in Azusa | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Azusa commercial movers for office suites, storefronts and business parks: building COIs, elevator windows and staged weekend jobs inside an 8AM to 6PM day.
heroSubtitle: Office suites, downtown storefronts and business-park units relocated in planned stages, seven days a week between 8AM and 6PM

faq.question: Does our Azusa building need a certificate of insurance before the move?
faq.answer: Most managed buildings and business parks do, and the manager normally wants the landlord and the management company named as additional insureds. We issue the certificate for $50 and send it ahead of the date. Give us the exact wording your building uses when you book, because a certificate naming the wrong entity stops the crew at the dock.

faq.question: Can you move our office on a Saturday or a Sunday?
faq.answer: Yes. Crews run Monday through Sunday between 8AM and 6PM, so a weekend start is available all year, although there is no overnight shift. Friday to Sunday hours cost more than Monday to Thursday, so many clients put archives and store rooms on a weekday stage and keep the weekend for the desks people need first.

faq.question: Where does the truck stand if the building has no loading dock?
faq.answer: On the street or in a marked loading zone, and both run on a clock here. A commercial vehicle over 6,000 lb is limited to 60 minutes at the curb, with active pickup or delivery to the adjacent building as the exception, and an alley stop is capped at 20 minutes with ten feet of passage left clear. We carry in relays so the truck keeps working through its window.

faq.question: How is a commercial move in Azusa priced?
faq.answer: By the hour and by crew size. Two movers with a truck are $119 in cash Monday to Thursday and $129 by card, and the rate rises with the third and fourth mover and again from Friday to Sunday. Every booking has a three-hour minimum, four hours once the address is 30+ miles from our base, travel time doubled beyond 10 miles, and overtime after eight hours.

faq.question: Can we move one department at a time?
faq.answer: That is how most business moves here are run. The job is split into dated stages, each with its own crew size, and labels carry the stage number so nothing arrives early. If a stage has to stay loaded until the next morning, overnight storage on the truck is $200.

faq.question: Do you handle safes, heavy equipment or an office piano?
faq.answer: Anything over 300 lbs is quoted at $150 above the hourly rate and moved with a crew of three. A piano standing in a reception area or a staff lounge costs $200 and books four movers. Mention the weight and the floor at the quote stage, because a single heavy item sets the crew size for the whole day.
